title: Backup
warning: The backup contains staff PIN hashes and customer phone numbers. Keep this drive safe.
never: No backup has been taken on this counter yet.
reminder: Back up today: there has been no backup in the last 7 days, and this shop's only off-machine copy is a USB backup.

auto.never: No automatic backup yet: one is taken every hour.
auto.failing: Automatic backups are failing ({{code}}). Check the disk space on this counter.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.intro: Replace this counter's data with a backup. The current data is backed up first, the app restarts, and you finish the restore with your PIN before the till opens again.
restore.none: No backups on this counter yet.
restore.confirmBody: Everything recorded after this backup will be replaced. If the counter syncs with the cloud, its own sales are brought back when you finish the restore.
restore.restarting: The backup is ready. The app is restarting…

recovery.title: Finish the restore
recovery.intro: This counter was restored from a backup. Nothing can be sold until the Owner finishes the restore.

mode.online: Bring back this counter's sales from the cloud

modeHint.online: Recommended. Needs the internet: everything this counter sent to the cloud after the backup comes back.
modeHint.offline: When the cloud can't be reached, or on a new PC. This counter gets a new code; its history stays in the cloud and comes back once it is registered again.
modeHint.local: This store doesn't use the cloud, so the sales made after the backup can't be recovered.

fresh.title: Restore this counter from a backup
fresh.intro: Choose the counter's backup file (a USB drive, or a copy from the old PC). Then finish the restore with the Owner's PIN.
